declarations.description:
Interactive editor for UML class, object and sequence diagrams.
Authors configure the available diagram types, elements, limits and validation rules and can provide a
starting diagram that learners can reset to. Learners model their solution directly in the widget.
declarations.name: WebwriterUmlDiagram

cssParts.description: The row of diagram tabs above the frame.
cssParts.name: tabs

cssParts.description: The bordered frame around the toolbar and the canvas. Theme: the text and line color of the diagrams follow `--ww-text-color`, the font follows `--ww-font-family`, and the selected and hovered marks and the active tab follow `--ww-theme-accent-1`; without them the colors are unchanged. Pointer, touch and keyboard: every class, relation, lifeline and message is focusable on the canvas, arrow keys move it, Enter opens its drawer, Delete removes it and a long press opens the menu. The widget is laid out for widths from 300 to 2100 px. On paper the toolbars and controls are left out and the shown diagram is fitted to the page and printed whole. Conversions: the shown diagram exports as PlantUML (`.puml`, also as a `pre`), as SVG (`image/svg+xml`, also as an `img` with a data URL) and, with the settings, all diagrams as JSON (`.json`, the content of the data block, lossless). PlantUML and SVG carry names, members, relation types, multiplicities and relation names (class and object diagrams), or lifelines, messages, activations and fragments (sequence diagrams); they drop settings, positions (they are laid out again on import), relation roles, and the other two diagrams. A PlantUML file or `pre` with classes becomes the class diagram, one with `object` the object diagram and one with participants the sequence diagram; lines outside this subset are skipped. The JSON file replaces the settings and all three diagrams.
cssParts.name: frame

members.name: objectDiagramData

members.name: _classDiagramCheckpoint
members.description:
Checkpoints learners can return to: the diagrams as saved by the author, i.e. as loaded.
Taken from the attributes on the first update, so they are not affected by later (learner) changes.

members.name: SAVE_DELAY
members.description:
Diagram changes are written to the attributes only after editing has paused for this long (ms).
WebWriter records every attribute change as its own undo step, and a single user action
(e.g. creating a relation) can emit several intermediate states.

members.name: _pendingSaves
members.description: Pending diagram changes by diagram type, applied together after SAVE_DELAY

members.name: #data
members.description: The widget's JSON data block: settings and diagram contents, saved under the keys of the stored object

members.name: _clearProseMirrorNodeSelection
members.description:
WebWriter selects the widget on every press, which can turn into a DOM range around it that highlights
all of its texts. Remove that range (the widget stays selected), but leave text fields alone.

members.name: _scheduleSave
members.description: Schedules a diagram change to be written once editing has paused, replacing an earlier pending one

members.name: _flushSaves
members.description: Writes all pending diagram changes

members.name: _shownDiagram

type.text: { puml: string | null; svg: string | null }

members.description: The shown diagram as PlantUML text and as SVG, or `null` values when it is empty

members.name: _applyPlantUml
members.description: Replaces the shown diagram with a parsed PlantUML diagram and shows it

members.name: _handleToggleFullscreen
members.description: Handles fullscreen toggle requests from the editors

members.name: _handleSequenceModelChanged
members.description: Handles model changes from the sequence diagram container

members.name: _handleDiagramDataChanged
members.description: Handles diagram data changes from the class/object diagram editor

members.name: _handleSettingsUpdate
